# Opal Pettigrew

## Overview

- **Age:** 19 or 20 years old at the time of her death  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c11 P11](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0011), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v3 c11 P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004), [v3 c14 P1](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Opal is described as an extremely attractive young woman with a radiant complexion, large vivid blue eyes, and long, beautiful yellow hair braids. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby compares her striking appearance to large, crimson peonies rather than white lilies. As her illness progresses, she becomes pale and fragile with a feverishly intense flush, though she remains beautiful until her death.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v3 c11 P5](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0005), [v3 c14 P31](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0031)_

## Personality

Opal is a cheerful, lively, and highly feminine girl who loves fun, fancy clothes, and social attention. She is preoccupied with romance, suitors, and male attention, often boasting about her admirers. Her sentimentality shows in her story writing, which tends to be excessively romantic. Despite her superficial tendencies, she is warm-hearted and faces her terminal illness with a tragic, desperate attempt to remain cheerful.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v3 c14 P1](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0001)_

- Flirtatious and romantic  <sub>[v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v3 c11 P8](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0008)</sub>

## Goals

- To be surrounded by suitors and enjoy a gay youth before settling down into marriage  <sub>[v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005), [v3 c14 P17](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0017)</sub>
- To qualify and work as a schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c30 P15](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0015), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v3 c14 P1](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0001)</sub>

## History

Opal attended Brierley school, where she frequently sat near Nell Harcourt and participated in local activities, such as writing stories for the local story club. She studied for the Regent's entrance exam in Miss Thorne's extra class and later attended Regent's Academy in Portmaris. After completing her studies at Regent's, she qualified as a teacher. During her time in Portmaris and back in Brierley, she enjoyed a lively social life surrounded by numerous male admirers. However, she contracted a severe bout of lung congestion during the winter, which developed into terminal consumption. Despite her declining health, Opal tried to maintain her cheerful disposition and planned to teach at Pale Sands school. She eventually confided her deep fear of death to Nell Harcourt shortly before passing away quietly in her sleep.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v3 c11 P5](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0005), [v3 c14 P1](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0001), [v3 c14 P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)_
